findings.claim: diagrams-stay-current.md required a depicts front matter field that no ADR names
measure-before-ticketing.md and docs-layout.md gave different homes for spikes

verdict.text: Both findings sent back are fixed and the fixes broke nothing they touched.
The gates are green on the new tree, so the change can be committed.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and eval rows r1 to r4 pass; "stamp green: 4779b49f61eadc61fbe2693e1bec7d717d314bfdd0e5fb766f38f4341daaf3bb".

Read diagrams-stay-current.md, measure-before-ticketing.md and docs-layout.md in full against ADR 0009, the manifesto (I4, the bundle folders including `prototypes/` and `architecture/`) and okf-bundle.md.
The rule now puts what a diagram depicts in a `## Depicts` body section and says it adds no extension field, which matches ADR 0009 ("Adding any other extension field needs its own ADR").
The hand check now reads ids from that section.

measure-before-ticketing.md says a plan-risk spike runs through `loopctl plan spike` and stays in `.loop/`, and analysis behind a cited number is a prototype in `.okf/prototypes/<name>/`, pointing at docs-layout.md.
docs-layout.md's audience-gates-the-folder constraint now says the same, and prototypes-hold-their-scripts is unchanged and consistent.
